RADIO LEGEND

Radio name & colour

Name and colour are saved in this browser. The colour applies to the legend, position dots and tracks. Choose Default colour then Save changes to restore it. The original radio ID is retained.

RADIO OPTIONS

Connect your radio

Choose a serial connection, then listen for reports or poll a list of radios.

Start python radio-map/serve.py on the radio PC. Enter the key printed in its terminal. Your browser may ask for local-network access.

Pair the private website with this PC

Use this companion key in the private website on this PC. Keep the local server running.

You can replace the key at any time. Forgetting a pairing does not stop a session running on the radio PC.

One radio per line: ID, interval in seconds. Polling transmits location requests; radios must support TAIT AVL polling.

Sessions save KML, raw captures and event logs on the radio PC. Stop other serial applications before connecting.
